<section class="atlas-reading">
  <div class="atlas-section-heading">
    <span class="atlas-kicker">Interpretation</span>
    <h2>How the spaces differ</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="atlas-reading-grid">
    <article>
      <span>01</span>
      <h3>Lower arousal</h3>
      <p>ChatGPT placed all four category means lower on arousal, with the largest drops for fearful and disgusting images.</p>
    </article>
    <article>
      <span>02</span>
      <h3>Mirthful shift</h3>
      <p>Mirthful images moved strongly toward lower valence in ChatGPT ratings (ΔV = −1.81).</p>
    </article>
    <article>
      <span>03</span>
      <h3>Disgusting shift</h3>
      <p>Disgusting images moved toward higher valence in ChatGPT ratings (ΔV = +1.08), while arousal decreased.</p>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="atlas-method-strip" aria-label="Study summary">
  <span><strong>224</strong> images</span>
  <span><strong>4</strong> categories</span>
  <span><strong>2</strong> sources</span>
  <span><strong>1–9</strong> rating scale</span>
  <span><strong>Valence × Arousal</strong> space</span>
</section>
